# Meridian

Meridian is an omnichannel B2B SaaS support platform with native revenue intelligence.

Meridian helps B2B SaaS leaders identify stalled adoption, product friction, silent churn, expansion signals, and renewal risk hiding inside support interactions.

## Key pages

- Homepage: https://meridianarr.com/
- Comparison: https://meridianarr.com/compare/meridian-vs-pylon-zendesk-salesforce/
- Value Continuity Report: https://meridianarr.com/arr-defense-report.pdf

## Core concepts

- Value Continuity
- Post-sale revenue intelligence
- Customer Distress Index
- B2B SaaS support
- Product friction
- Renewal risk
- Support tickets as revenue signals
- SaaS reset
- Build-versus-buy risk

## Summary

Traditional help desks manage support activity. Meridian connects support activity to account-level revenue intelligence so leaders can see where customer value is being created, where it is breaking down, and what to do before ARR is at risk.
